coordinate_system.origin: the Pillow la (left/ascent) origin at the top of one native text row
coordinate_system.baseline: baseline_px pixels below the row origin; baseline_px equals the native Pillow ascent
coordinate_system.x: positive right in pixels; text advances by advance_px without fitting
coordinate_system.y: positive down in pixels; bearing_y is the logical glyph-top offset from row top
coordinate_system.atlas_rect: [x0, y0, x1, y1), atlas pixels containing the true binary ink crop
coordinate_system.ink_bounds: [x0, y0, x1, y1), true binary ink bounds relative to the row origin
coordinate_system.natural_overhang: preserved; atlas packing never clamps ink to advance_px

candidate_admission.missing_char_policy: fail closed; no fallback, substitution, or .notdef
